prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide cinematic original homepage hero photograph, single image, 2048x1152 landscape. Primary request: the extraordinary quiet beauty of Kenya at first light, photographed from a real-looking elegant safari lodge veranda. Broad untouched savannah and layered distant hills, one characteristic mature umbrella acacia occupying the right third, natural green-gold grass and soft atmospheric depth. A restrained sliver of warm stone terrace and one beautiful simple timber-and-linen lounge chair at the extreme right foreground, no pool. Leave the left half visually calm and darker with softly shaded grass and distant landscape for white website copy. Natural side light from the right; richly resolved branches and grass, believable gentle dawn haze, pale blue sky. The landscape is the star, not a resort building. Luxury travel magazine photography with honest camera detail, 35mm full-frame lens, deep enough focus, neutral warm color balance and subtle grain. No people, no wildlife, no text, no logos, no orange filter, no painting, no CGI, no floating objects, no implausible geography. One cohesive photograph, not a collage. Illustrative Kenyan setting, not a named property.
